newsitem.title: USA: Lindsay sees irrigation products demand.
newsitem.headline: Lindsay sees irrigation products demand.

text.p: Lindsay Manufacturing Co said it expects demand in fiscal 1997 for center pivot and lateral move irrigation equipment to continue to outpace projected long-term, average annual market growth of six to eight percent.

The Lincoln, Neb. farm equipment maker, in its annual report, said the farm economy should remain healthy through fiscal 1997, supported by continued strong commodity pricing and the positive effects of the Freedom to Farm Act.

"We plan to invest up to an additional $3.5 million to $4.5 million in plant automation, principally to expand our metal fabrication, welding, machining and galvanizing capacity," said chairman Gary Parker in a letter to shareholders.
Parker said these process improvements and expansions should further improve the company's capacity by 10 to 20 percent.
Lindsay also said it will grow through acquisition. It said it was well positioned, with cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities of $54.4 million.
